svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: XBRL schema map (as of 2026-09-03)
svg.desc: Entity-relationship diagram of the xbrl PostgreSQL schema: company, filing, concept, fact and load_run tables joined by their foreign keys, with fact at the centre. Every relationship is one-to-many. Hand-drawn snapshot dated 2026-09-03 — verify against app/db/models.py.
svg.text: Every relationship is one-to-many — the bar marks the “one” end, the crow’s foot the “many” end. Arrows run from a primary key to the referencing column.
